main_text.p: fum admittat. מִשִׁיטָא[?] Certum, Simplex, Absolutum : מִשִׁיטָא לְךָ[?] Certúmne tibi est, Certúsne es? פְּשִׁיטִין מְשׁוּטִין[?] Nummi minimi, indivisibiles.

p.i: Liquefacta est nix, R. David Ios.3.15.
Apertio : Initium, Ingressus, Prologus, Exordium libri vel sermonis.
Pathachatio, Notatio cum Pathach, Kimchi Psalm.19.14.
Minister cœtus vel synagogæ, Aedituus, negotia synagogæ curans.

page.notes: Hebrew vocalisation and some headwords are read from a low-resolution scan; words marked [?] are doubtful. Printed dictionary entries use italic Latin glosses and Hebrew lemmata. The letter division צ is a bare letter, so it is set as a paragraph. The running head shows the section letters פ צ as printed.
